body:
I had recently acquired hydro from a friend. It was a 10mg dose. I had done research and finally decided to take it.
I took it at 10pm expecting the best. 30 minutes pass, nothing. An hour, nothing. I don't even feel slight warmth that others report. After about 2 hours, I am lying in bed trying to fall asleep, I start to see tie dye-ish colors in my eyelids that begins pulsating. I focus hard on this and I get about 7 waves, about 2 seconds apart each, that feel like warm orgasms. This leaves me slightly happy. Then I open my eyes and see T.V. static vision. Nothing else happens.
I don't know why this would have happened. This was my first drug ever and I barely did anything. I would pay to feel those waves of pleasure again, but that's it.
I considered a higher dose but it would be a waste due to my 'tolerance
